verse: So rend your hearts and not your garments, and return to the LORD your God. For He is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion. And He relents from sending disaster.
story: With the locusts gone through the land and a darker day on the horizon, God says something no one expected: even now, come back.

In Israel grief was shown by tearing your clothes. Joel asks for a deeper tear. Rip open the heart, the inner core where God alone sees, and turn your whole self back toward Him. The reason to come is not the size of the fast but the character of the LORD. Joel reaches back to the words God spoke to Moses at Sinai: gracious, compassionate, slow to anger, full of steadfast love. The door is open because of who stands behind it.
Ash Wednesday marks us with dust, but the invitation is not to despair. Bring Him an honest heart today; He is already turned toward you.
theme: Ash Wednesday: dust, repentance, return to the LORD
